scope: v11 full10 discovery only; no new GPTQ, validation, PPL, or quantized-prefix run

search_features.search_gain_median: median of the 10 per-split search_gain values for a row
search_features.search_margin_per_split: (second_smallest_search_SSE - smallest_search_SSE) / second_smallest_search_SSE, with distinct candidate entries ranked by search_SSE then alpha ascending
search_features.search_margin_median: median of the 10 per-split search_margin values for a row

decision_rule: ACCEPT row iff search_gain_median >= tau_gain AND search_margin_median >= tau_margin; otherwise FALLBACK row to alpha=1.0
decision_granularity: row; ACCEPT applies each split's own search-best alpha, FALLBACK applies alpha=1.0 in every split

comparators.D: all rows use native dynamic GPTQ alpha=1.0
comparators.C: all rows use per-split search-best shared-alpha dynamic GPTQ
comparators.Gate: accepted rows use C, fallback rows use D

heldout_evaluation.retained_gain_definition: Gate_pooled_gain / C_pooled_gain, only defined when C_pooled_gain > 0
heldout_evaluation.worst_regression: minimum per-row/split heldout gain; zero when all decisions fallback

selection_among_pass: threshold numeric simplicity: fewest total nonzero decimal places after stripping trailing zeros; then tau_gain ascending; then tau_margin ascending
no_pass_behavior: write GATE_V1_DISCOVERY_FAIL in report and stop; do not create GATE_V1.json or validation plan
